digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud Jira descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through the production codec path.
Data Center Jira descriptions and comments must render Markdown as native wiki markup through a segmenting renderer (with fallback for unsafe content).
Bidirectional sync must maintain echo safety via per-binding baseline, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way LWW comparison without silent overwrites.
Jira-authored constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive rebar-originated reconcile passes via origin-gated outbound normalization.
An unchanged reconcile pass must add zero committed-state entries and the second pass must perform no body update (convergence proof).
Comment creation must route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions with append-only Jira comment ID persistence.
